name: Jus AI by Jus Mundi (Light Mode)

Jus Mundi combines the world's largest curated arbitration database with Jus AI's agentic intelligence to help you analyze cases, identify winning arguments, and deliver verified citations across multiple jurisdictions and languages. Transform research from hours to minutes without sacrificing the accuracy your practice demands.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Jus AI by Jus Mundi (Light Mode) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Jus AI by Jus Mundi (Light Mode) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.jusmundi.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Jus AI by Jus Mundi (Light Mode) MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jus AI by Jus Mundi (Light Mode) provides these MCP tools: legal_research.

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Jus AI by Jus Mundi (Light Mode) in search-research on the Manufact MCP catalog include Agentic Atlas: Agent Design Patterns, common-practice, GDELT Cloud, BookDNA, and Lyon.

_published_faq.name: Does Jus AI by Jus Mundi (Light Mode) MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jus AI by Jus Mundi (Light Mode) requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Jus AI by Jus Mundi (Light Mode)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jus AI by Jus Mundi (Light Mode) is developed by Jus Mundi. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
